written.headline: Anthropic launches Claude Whiteboards, Sheets, and Data
written.summary: Anthropic is rolling out Claude Whiteboards and Claude Sheets in beta, alongside Claude Data, to let paid users collaborate with the assistant on shared planning, spreadsheets, and data. The tools operate on web, desktop, and mobile, allowing teams to keep documents within Claude before exporting to partner platforms.

written.headline: Grok Build coding agent leaks confidential data from thousands of user apps
written.summary: Security researchers found that thousands of apps created using SpaceXSI's Grok Build coding agent exposed confidential business, employee, and personal data because they could be accessed without sign-in. Out of 37,571 tested apps, 35,578 opened without authentication, including 24 internal apps belonging to SpaceXSI.

written.headline: AMD launches Zen 6 EPYC Venice processors with up to 256 cores
written.summary: AMD has announced the availability of its EPYC 9006 \"Venice\" series processors featuring up to 256 Zen 6c cores per socket. The new enterprise processors utilize a 2nm manufacturing process and support up to 16 channels of DDR5-8000 or MRDIMM-12800 memory.

written.headline: OpenAI's adjusted operating margin improved to -109% in Q3
written.summary: Leaked documents show OpenAI's adjusted operating margin improved from -150% in Q2 to -109% in Q3. During the same period, the company's revenue grew by roughly 50% to reach $10 billion.

written.headline: Graphon Labs raises $35m Series A for AI agent memory infrastructure
written.summary: Graphon Labs raised a $35 million Series A funding round led by RRE Ventures to scale persistent-memory infrastructure for AI agents. The round brings the 20-person startup's total funding to $43.3 million.

written.headline: Amazon announces Ring AI security drone and roving business robot
written.summary: Amazon's Ring launched a new robotics division debuting the Ring Drone Cam indoor flying camera for $249.99 and the Ring Rover Cam business robot for $999.99. Both autonomous devices use an AI Pilot system to map floor plans, navigate obstacles, and respond to security triggers.

written.headline: Anthropic brings Claude assistant to Google Meet for live workplace tasks
written.summary: Anthropic launched Claude Meetings in beta on Google Meet, allowing its AI assistant to join video calls as a visible participant to draft plans and answer questions in real time. The company also announced Claude Whiteboards and Claude Sheets alongside a roadshow for its US initial public offering.
